steps.what: Prepare a grant application from the chosen project and verified funding requirements

loop.purpose: Draft application prose after the director selects the project and confirms facts
loop.input: project proposal, verified project facts, funding criteria
loop.output: grant application draft with source-linked claims and missing-field flags
loop.check: Director checks eligibility, project claims, deliverables, financial consistency, and absence of invented commitments
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unresolved eligibility or unsupported claims require manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Application prose must explain a project against narrative criteria; fixed fields alone are insufficient

steps.what: Verify the grant application and submit the authorised version
Develop production budgets and resolve resource trade-offs
Negotiate contracts within the agreed production and financial authority
Design and print programmes and other promotional materials for the production

tasks.design: Use a bounded grant-prose draft in {DOCS} while retaining eligibility checks and submission. Budgets in {SPREADSHEET}, contract negotiation in {CLM}, and programme design and printing in {OTHER} retain their active work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Grant prose must explain the particular project without inventing commitments.
tasks.enabler_now: An editable draft can work from confirmed project facts and selected funding criteria.
tasks.still_hard: Funding fit, resource choices, contract trade-offs, and truthful external promises.
tasks.human_edge: The director knows what the production can realistically deliver and negotiates accordingly.
tasks.altitude: A small amount of grant prose work may be reduced; financial and contractual authority stays unchanged.

reach.task: Check a grant narrative against project commitments

evidence.claim: Source-constrained grant drafting may reduce prose work; no measured music-administration saving is established here.

assumptions: Boundary covers the director's administrative workload mix. Grant, budget, contract and promotional episodes are not all mandatory for each transaction; budget outputs precede any negotiation that relies on them. Existing project costs for an application are supplied before s1, rather than taken from a later budget step.

Director verifies project purpose, dates, audience, activities, costs, requested amount, source evidence and proposed commitments during s1; capture and selection remain within its 80% retained time. Missing facts block prose completion and return to manual preparation.

OTHER is the programme-layout and printing toolset. Confirmed performance information is supplied by the event owner before s5 through unchanged work. No printing, budget arithmetic, or current system runtime earns a new saving.
Test native application and programme templates before a custom loop. Contract signature stays with the existing authorised signatory and is outside the negotiation step.
research_questions: Does grant drafting reduce effort after fact preparation and full commitment verification are counted?

already_counted.description: Verify and submit the exact grant application

incremental.description: Maintain source instructions and check recurring application drafting errors

approvals.approved_version: Exact application text, financial figures, attachments, commitments and funding destination; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=95; gross 5 minus 3 upkeep gives net 2. Range assumes a conventional grant narrative within a broad administration workload; negotiation-heavy periods may save nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Define film and television music with producers and directors

steps.what: Confer with producers and directors about the nature and placement of screen music

tasks.design: Keep the spotting and creative discussion human, using the screen-playback application {OTHER}. The composer and production team agree where music helps and what effect it should have.
tasks.previous_blocker: Musical placement depends on dramatic interpretation and shared creative intent.
tasks.enabler_now: No automated replacement for the discussion is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling different interpretations of a scene and deciding when silence serves it better.
tasks.human_edge: The composer listens to the director's intent and challenges a cue that weakens the scene.
tasks.altitude: Creative collaboration and decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Explain the musical implications of a sequence change
reach.learn: Picture versions and cue timing conventions

evidence.claim: Screen-music placement requires contextual creative collaboration; no labour saving is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is composer participation in the creative music-placement discussion, excluding composing cues and production-team labour. OTHER is the screen-playback application.
Producer or editor supplies the current sequence before discussion; participants provide intent and constraints during s1. No structured emotion or cue-placement feed is required.
Existing native playback and notes remain sufficient; an unchanged process adds zero incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Which placement choices require direct discussion of dramatic intent?

incremental.description: No additional system or process upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; net saving zero because creative discussion remains unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Fill in orchestral sketches and vocal parts

steps.what: Fill in orchestral sketch details and add appropriate vocal parts to scores

tasks.design: Retain substantive orchestration and vocal writing in the notation application {OTHER}. Native notation entry and playback support the work without claiming that transcription supplies the missing musical decisions.
tasks.previous_blocker: A sketch deliberately leaves musical choices unresolved.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported replacement for filling those artistic details is established here.
tasks.still_hard: Voice leading, balance, range, text setting, and consistency with the composition.
tasks.human_edge: The composer hears how a new part changes the whole musical texture.
tasks.altitude: Orchestration and vocal-writing authority remain unchanged.

reach.task: Discuss whether a vocal line is practical and expressive
reach.learn: Voice range, breathing, and text setting

evidence.claim: Audio transcription does not establish the artistic choices needed to complete an orchestral sketch; no saving is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is substantive completion of an existing sketch, excluding exact transcription of already decided notes and general high-level composition choices. OTHER is the notation application.
Composer creates added musical details during s1 from the existing sketch; no complete vocal-part specification or generated musical-quality flag is presumed.
Native notation tools remain the first choice; current playback runtime earns no new saving and unchanged practice adds zero upkeep.
research_questions: Which sketch details are unresolved composition rather than mechanical copying?

incremental.description: No new system or process upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; net saving zero. Substantive orchestration and vocal-part creation remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop musical ideas from imagination and environmental sound

steps.what: Explore and develop musical ideas from imagination or sounds in the environment

tasks.design: Retain the composer's listening, imagination, and motif development. Existing sketches in {DOCS} may preserve ideas, but no automated substitute for discovering their musical meaning is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: An interesting idea is not specified before the creative exploration begins.
tasks.enabler_now: No change to creative discovery is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising potential in a sound and turning it into something worth developing.
tasks.human_edge: The composer connects an observation to personal musical intention.
tasks.altitude: Creative discovery remains part of the composer's own work.

reach.task: Discuss an environmental sound's musical possibilities

evidence.claim: Idea discovery and development are retained as artistic work without an assumed labour saving.

assumptions: Boundary covers discovering and developing motifs, excluding synthesizer trials and later notation counted in separate tasks; overlapping creative effort is assigned once in roll-up.
Composer supplies imagination and listens to the environment during s1. No pre-existing structured motif brief, extraction step, or source feed is assumed.
Existing sketches suffice; no custom software or new upkeep is introduced.
research_questions: Which activities are discovery itself rather than removable recording or copying?

incremental.description: No additional system or process upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net saving zero because creative exploration remains unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The musician may reduce a little grant prose work while retaining budget, negotiation, collaboration, and artistic responsibilities.
role.ambitious_version: A musician who makes realistic production commitments and preserves direct responsibility for musical choices.
